summary: A security round that fixes the November 21 security check. The five daily Reels still post on their own, but now only when they hold no outside links, web addresses, @handles, emails, phone numbers or "DM us" asks, and the news and other creators' posts the pipeline reads can no longer steer what it writes. Claude now runs without any of the specialist's keys, the Instagram token in the Vault gets its own lock, Hitta can no longer read hidden tables or be talked into un-pausing by text it read, and the YouTube backfill respects Pause.
frontend: This Latest Update box, on the Social Media Specialist page.

A Reel whose caption, cover or on-screen words have an outside link, web address, @handle, email, phone number or "DM us" ask doesn't post; the History says which check stopped it and that slot is skipped.
Hitta's answers now say the five daily Reels post on their own when they pass every check, and that Pause stops them.
Asking Hitta to resume only works when you say so yourself ("resume", "turn it back on", "start posting again").
other: News articles and other creators' captions, transcripts and patterns reach Claude only as cleaned-up, marked data: tags, links, @handles and brackets are taken out, and every prompt says to never follow instructions inside them.

Claude runs with only its own sign-in (no Vault, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Hitta or ElevenLabs keys), no MCP servers, and only the Read tool where it needs one, which can't read the process's secrets.

New optional secret SOCIAL_SEAL_KEY: once set, the stored Instagram and Page token is locked with it instead of a key made from the shared Vault database token. Tokens locked the old way still open and are locked again with the new key.
Tokens made during a run (the Facebook Page token, YouTube access) are masked in the public GitHub logs.
Hitta's database reads refuse hidden tables however they're written (quoted names, pragma functions, tables starting with _).
The YouTube backfill uploads nothing while paused, and "go" needs YOUTUBE_CROSSPOST on.
GitHub Actions are pinned to exact versions, the Claude CLI is pinned to 2.1.330, installs run without any secrets or install scripts, and checkout keeps no GitHub token.
Dependabot proposes monthly updates as pull requests; SECURITY.md says how to report a problem.
